WITH q AS (
WITH r AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT t.*, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS nm_workspace, COALESCE(concat(d_workspace.n, ' (', CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING), ')'), CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS n_workspace, COALESCE(d_warehouse.n, CAST(t.`warehouse_id` AS STRING)) AS nm_warehouse, COALESCE(concat(d_warehouse.n, ' (', CAST(t.`warehouse_id` AS STRING), ')'), CAST(t.`warehouse_id` AS STRING)) AS n_warehouse, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS ws_name, CASE WHEN COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) IS NULL THEN COALESCE(d_warehouse.n, CAST(t.`warehouse_id` AS STRING)) ELSE concat(COALESCE(d_warehouse.n, CAST(t.`warehouse_id` AS STRING)), ' · ', COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING))) END AS lbl_warehouse FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.compute_warehouse_idle_minutes t LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id, max(name) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_workspace GROUP BY CAST(workspace_id AS STRING)) d_workspace ON d_workspace.workspace_id = CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING) LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id, CAST(warehouse_id AS STRING) AS warehouse_id, max(warehouse_name) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_warehouse GROUP BY CAST(workspace_id AS STRING), CAST(warehouse_id AS STRING)) d_warehouse ON d_warehouse.workspace_id = CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING) AND d_warehouse.warehouse_id = CAST(t.`warehouse_id` AS STRING)) WHERE (array_contains(:workspace, COALESCE(ws_name, '')) OR array_contains(:workspace, 'all')) AND not_assessed_reason IS NULL),
top AS (SELECT workspace_id, warehouse_id, lbl_warehouse FROM r ORDER BY running_minutes DESC LIMIT 8)
SELECT tw.lbl_warehouse AS warehouse, 'Busy' AS segment, SUM(r.busy_minutes) / 60.0 AS hours
FROM r JOIN top tw ON tw.workspace_id = r.workspace_id AND tw.warehouse_id = r.warehouse_id GROUP BY 1, 2
UNION ALL
SELECT tw.lbl_warehouse, 'Idle over 1 min', SUM(r.counted_idle_minutes) / 60.0
FROM r JOIN top tw ON tw.workspace_id = r.workspace_id AND tw.warehouse_id = r.warehouse_id GROUP BY 1, 2
UNION ALL
SELECT tw.lbl_warehouse, 'Short pauses', SUM(GREATEST(r.idle_minutes - r.counted_idle_minutes, 0)) / 60.0
FROM r JOIN top tw ON tw.workspace_id = r.workspace_id AND tw.warehouse_id = r.warehouse_id GROUP BY 1, 2
),
r AS (SELECT `segment` AS s, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(`hours`) DESC) AS rk FROM q WHERE `segment` IS NOT NULL GROUP BY `segment`),
n AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM r)
SELECT q.`warehouse`, q.`hours`,
       CASE WHEN q.`segment` IS NULL OR r.rk < 8 OR n.n <= 8 THEN CAST(q.`segment` AS STRING) ELSE 'Other' END AS `segment`
FROM q LEFT JOIN r ON r.s = q.`segment` CROSS JOIN n

queryLines:
WITH w AS (
  SELECT m.*, COALESCE(dw.warehouse_name, m.warehouse_id) AS resource_name,
         COALESCE(ws.name, m.workspace_id, 'Account-level') AS workspace_name
  FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.compute_warehouse_idle_minutes m
  LEFT JOIN databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_warehouse dw ON dw.warehouse_id = m.warehouse_id
  LEFT JOIN databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_workspace ws ON ws.workspace_id = m.workspace_id
),
autostop AS (
  SELECT *,
         CASE WHEN warehouse_kind = 'serverless' THEN 1 ELSE 10 END AS target_minutes,
         CASE WHEN warehouse_kind = 'serverless' THEN autostop_1_idle_minutes ELSE autostop_10_idle_minutes END AS target_idle_minutes,
         CASE WHEN warehouse_kind = 'serverless' THEN autostop_1_cold_starts ELSE autostop_10_cold_starts END AS target_cold_starts
  FROM w
),
saving AS (
  SELECT *,
         CASE WHEN auto_stop_minutes IS NOT NULL AND (auto_stop_minutes = 0 OR auto_stop_minutes > target_minutes)
                   AND autostop_now_idle_minutes IS NOT NULL AND target_idle_minutes IS NOT NULL
                   AND usd_per_cluster_minute IS NOT NULL
              THEN ROUND((autostop_now_idle_minutes - target_idle_minutes) * usd_per_cluster_minute * (1.0 - 0.0), 2)
         END AS saving_usd,
         GREATEST(COALESCE(target_cold_starts, 0) - COALESCE(autostop_now_cold_starts, 0), 0) AS extra_cold_starts
  FROM autostop
)

SELECT concat(resource_name, ' · ', workspace_name) AS warehouse, ROUND(MAX(saving_usd), 0) AS usd
FROM saving
WHERE saving_usd >= 1 AND (array_contains(:workspace, COALESCE(workspace_name, '')) OR array_contains(:workspace, 'all'))
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 8

  SELECT *,
         CASE WHEN auto_stop_minutes IS NULL THEN '6 Unknown'
              WHEN auto_stop_minutes = 0 THEN '5 Off'
              WHEN auto_stop_minutes <= 5 THEN '1 Up to 5 min'
              WHEN auto_stop_minutes <= 15 THEN '2 6-15 min'
              WHEN auto_stop_minutes <= 30 THEN '3 16-30 min'

  FROM (SELECT t.*, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS nm_workspace, COALESCE(concat(d_workspace.n, ' (', CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING), ')'), CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS n_workspace, COALESCE(d_warehouse.n, CAST(t.`warehouse_id` AS STRING)) AS nm_warehouse, COALESCE(concat(d_warehouse.n, ' (', CAST(t.`warehouse_id` AS STRING), ')'), CAST(t.`warehouse_id` AS STRING)) AS n_warehouse, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS ws_name, CASE WHEN COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) IS NULL THEN COALESCE(d_warehouse.n, CAST(t.`warehouse_id` AS STRING)) ELSE concat(COALESCE(d_warehouse.n, CAST(t.`warehouse_id` AS STRING)), ' · ', COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING))) END AS lbl_warehouse FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.compute_warehouse_idle_minutes t LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id, max(name) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_workspace GROUP BY CAST(workspace_id AS STRING)) d_workspace ON d_workspace.workspace_id = CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING) LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id, CAST(warehouse_id AS STRING) AS warehouse_id, max(warehouse_name) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_warehouse GROUP BY CAST(workspace_id AS STRING), CAST(warehouse_id AS STRING)) d_warehouse ON d_warehouse.workspace_id = CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING) AND d_warehouse.warehouse_id = CAST(t.`warehouse_id` AS STRING))

       CASE WHEN q.`segment` IS NULL OR r.rk < 8 OR n.n <= 8 THEN CAST(q.`segment` AS STRING) ELSE 'Other' END AS `segment`

WITH w AS (
  SELECT m.*, COALESCE(dw.warehouse_name, m.warehouse_id) AS resource_name,
         COALESCE(ws.name, m.workspace_id, 'Account-level') AS workspace_name
  FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.compute_warehouse_idle_minutes m
  LEFT JOIN databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_warehouse dw ON dw.warehouse_id = m.warehouse_id
  LEFT JOIN databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_workspace ws ON ws.workspace_id = m.workspace_id
),
autostop AS (
  SELECT *,
         CASE WHEN warehouse_kind = 'serverless' THEN 1 ELSE 10 END AS target_minutes,
         CASE WHEN warehouse_kind = 'serverless' THEN autostop_1_idle_minutes ELSE autostop_10_idle_minutes END AS target_idle_minutes,
         CASE WHEN warehouse_kind = 'serverless' THEN autostop_1_cold_starts ELSE autostop_10_cold_starts END AS target_cold_starts
  FROM w
),
saving AS (
  SELECT *,
         CASE WHEN auto_stop_minutes IS NOT NULL AND (auto_stop_minutes = 0 OR auto_stop_minutes > target_minutes)
                   AND autostop_now_idle_minutes IS NOT NULL AND target_idle_minutes IS NOT NULL
                   AND usd_per_cluster_minute IS NOT NULL
              THEN ROUND((autostop_now_idle_minutes - target_idle_minutes) * usd_per_cluster_minute * (1.0 - 0.0), 2)
         END AS saving_usd,
         GREATEST(COALESCE(target_cold_starts, 0) - COALESCE(autostop_now_cold_starts, 0), 0) AS extra_cold_starts
  FROM autostop
)

SELECT concat(resource_name, ' · ', workspace_name) AS warehouse, warehouse_kind,
       CASE WHEN auto_stop_minutes = 0 OR auto_stop_minutes IS NULL THEN 'off' ELSE CAST(auto_stop_minutes AS STRING) END
            AS current_autostop,
       target_minutes, ROUND(COALESCE(saving_usd, 0), 0) AS saving_usd, extra_cold_starts
FROM saving
WHERE (array_contains(:workspace, COALESCE(workspace_name, '')) OR array_contains(:workspace, 'all'))
ORDER BY saving_usd DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 50

WITH c AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT t.*, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS nm_workspace, COALESCE(concat(d_workspace.n, ' (', CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING), ')'), CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS n_workspace, COALESCE(COALESCE(t.`cluster_name`, d_cluster.n), CAST(t.`cluster_id` AS STRING)) AS nm_cluster, COALESCE(concat(COALESCE(t.`cluster_name`, d_cluster.n), ' (', CAST(t.`cluster_id` AS STRING), ')'), CAST(t.`cluster_id` AS STRING)) AS n_cluster, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS ws_name, CASE WHEN COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) IS NULL THEN COALESCE(COALESCE(t.`cluster_name`, d_cluster.n), CAST(t.`cluster_id` AS STRING)) ELSE concat(COALESCE(COALESCE(t.`cluster_name`, d_cluster.n), CAST(t.`cluster_id` AS STRING)), ' · ', COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING))) END AS lbl_cluster FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.classic_clusters_config_current t LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id, max(name) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_workspace GROUP BY CAST(workspace_id AS STRING)) d_workspace ON d_workspace.workspace_id = CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING) LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id, CAST(cluster_id AS STRING) AS cluster_id, max(cluster_name) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_cluster GROUP BY CAST(workspace_id AS STRING), CAST(cluster_id AS STRING)) d_cluster ON d_cluster.workspace_id = CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING) AND d_cluster.cluster_id = CAST(t.`cluster_id` AS STRING)) WHERE (array_contains(:workspace, COALESCE(ws_name, '')) OR array_contains(:workspace, 'all')) AND cluster_source IN ('UI', 'API'))
SELECT CASE WHEN auto_termination_minutes IS NULL OR auto_termination_minutes = 0 THEN '6 Off'
            WHEN auto_termination_minutes <= 15 THEN '1 Up to 15 min' WHEN auto_termination_minutes <= 30 THEN '2 16-30 min'
            WHEN auto_termination_minutes <= 60 THEN '3 31-60 min' WHEN auto_termination_minutes <= 120 THEN '4 61-120 min'
            ELSE '5 Over 120 min' END AS band,
       count(*) AS clusters
FROM c
GROUP BY 1

datasets.displayName: clusters:All-purpose clusters that ran, auto-termination over 30 min
queryLines:
WITH cfg AS (SELECT cluster_id, auto_termination_minutes FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.classic_clusters_config_current WHERE cluster_source IN ('UI', 'API')),
idle AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT t.*, COALESCE(d_cluster.n, CAST(t.`cluster_id` AS STRING)) AS nm_cluster, COALESCE(concat(d_cluster.n, ' (', CAST(t.`cluster_id` AS STRING), ')'), CAST(t.`cluster_id` AS STRING)) AS n_cluster, COALESCE(d_wn.n, d_wv.workspace_id) AS ws_name, CASE WHEN COALESCE(d_wn.n, d_wv.workspace_id) IS NULL THEN COALESCE(d_cluster.n, CAST(t.`cluster_id` AS STRING)) ELSE concat(COALESCE(d_cluster.n, CAST(t.`cluster_id` AS STRING)), ' · ', COALESCE(d_wn.n, d_wv.workspace_id)) END AS lbl_cluster FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.compute_idle_node_ratio t LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(cluster_id AS STRING) AS cluster_id, max(cluster_name) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_cluster GROUP BY CAST(cluster_id AS STRING)) d_cluster ON d_cluster.cluster_id = CAST(t.`cluster_id` AS STRING) LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(cluster_id AS STRING) AS k, max(workspace_id) AS workspace_id FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_cluster GROUP BY 1) d_wv ON d_wv.k = CAST(t.`cluster_id` AS STRING) LEFT JOIN (SELECT workspace_id, max(name) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_workspace GROUP BY 1) d_wn ON d_wn.workspace_id = d_wv.workspace_id) WHERE (array_contains(:workspace, COALESCE(ws_name, '')) OR array_contains(:workspace, 'all')))
SELECT idle.nm_cluster AS cluster, idle.ws_name AS workspace,
       CASE WHEN cfg.auto_termination_minutes = 0 THEN 'off' ELSE CAST(cfg.auto_termination_minutes AS STRING) END AS auto_term,
       ROUND(idle.idle_ratio * 100, 0) AS idle_pct, ROUND(idle.est_wasted_usd_list * (1.0 - 0.0), 0) AS idle_usd,
       ROUND(idle.est_usd_list * (1.0 - 0.0), 0) AS total_usd
FROM idle JOIN cfg ON cfg.cluster_id = idle.cluster_id
WHERE cfg.auto_termination_minutes IS NULL OR cfg.auto_termination_minutes = 0 OR cfg.auto_termination_minutes > 30
ORDER BY idle.est_wasted_usd_list DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 50

datasets.name: 2b10ef0f
queryLines:
SELECT c.title AS check_title,
       c.page AS page,
       CASE WHEN l.query_id IS NULL THEN 'Not run'
            WHEN NOT l.ok THEN 'Not assessed'
            WHEN l.critical > 0 THEN 'Critical'
            WHEN l.warn > 0 THEN 'Warn'
            WHEN l.has_status THEN 'OK'
            WHEN l.row_count = 0 THEN 'No rows'
            ELSE 'Listed' END AS verdict,
       l.row_count AS row_count,
       l.critical AS critical_rows,
       l.warn AS warn_rows,
       l.error AS error
FROM (VALUES
       (0, 'compute_idle_node_ratio', 'Idle cluster nodes', 'Clusters & pools'),
       (1, 'node_timeline_utilization', 'Cluster node utilization over time', 'Clusters & pools'),
       (2, 'instance_pools_idle_capacity', 'Idle warm-pool capacity', 'Clusters & pools'),
       (3, 'instance_events_idle_active', 'Pool instance idle/active time', 'Clusters & pools'),
       (4, 'classic_clusters_config_current', 'Cluster configuration, current', 'Clusters & pools'),
       (5, 'node_types_reference', 'Node type reference', 'Clusters & pools')) AS c(ord, query_id, title, page)
LEFT JOIN databricks_audit_dashboard.snapshot_log l ON l.query_id = c.query_id
ORDER BY CASE WHEN l.critical > 0 THEN 0 WHEN l.warn > 0 THEN 1 WHEN NOT l.ok THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, c.ord

datasets.name: a77381cc
queryLines:
WITH q AS (
WITH c AS (
  SELECT cc.*, COALESCE(dw1.name, cc.workspace_id, 'Account-level') AS ws_name
  FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.compute_cluster_config_posture cc
  LEFT JOIN databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_workspace dw1 ON dw1.workspace_id = cc.workspace_id
),
cf AS (SELECT * FROM c WHERE status IN ('CRITICAL', 'WARN') AND (array_contains(:workspace, COALESCE(ws_name, '')) OR array_contains(:workspace, 'all'))),
w AS (
  SELECT wc.*, COALESCE(dw2.name, wc.workspace_id, 'Account-level') AS ws_name
  FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.compute_warehouse_config_posture wc
  LEFT JOIN databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_workspace dw2 ON dw2.workspace_id = wc.workspace_id
),
wf AS (SELECT * FROM w WHERE status = 'WARN' AND (array_contains(:workspace, COALESCE(ws_name, '')) OR array_contains(:workspace, 'all')))
SELECT 'No user isolation' AS flag, 'Cluster' AS kind, count(*) AS n FROM cf WHERE flag_no_isolation
UNION ALL SELECT 'End-of-support runtime', 'Cluster', count(*) FROM cf WHERE flag_eol_runtime
UNION ALL SELECT 'No policy', 'Cluster', count(*) FROM cf WHERE flag_no_policy
UNION ALL SELECT 'Auto-term off/too high', 'Cluster', count(*) FROM cf WHERE flag_auto_term_risk
UNION ALL SELECT 'Auto-stop off/too high', 'Warehouse', count(*) FROM wf WHERE flag_autostop_risk
UNION ALL SELECT 'Classic type', 'Warehouse', count(*) FROM wf WHERE flag_classic_type
UNION ALL SELECT 'Preview channel', 'Warehouse', count(*) FROM wf WHERE flag_preview_channel
),
r AS (SELECT `kind` AS s, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(`n`) DESC) AS rk FROM q WHERE `kind` IS NOT NULL GROUP BY `kind`),
n AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM r)
SELECT q.`flag`, q.`n`,
       CASE WHEN q.`kind` IS NULL OR r.rk < 8 OR n.n <= 8 THEN CAST(q.`kind` AS STRING) ELSE 'Other' END AS `kind`
FROM q LEFT JOIN r ON r.s = q.`kind` CROSS JOIN n

FROM (SELECT t.*, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS nm_workspace, COALESCE(concat(d_workspace.n, ' (', CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING), ')'), CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS n_workspace, COALESCE(COALESCE(t.`cluster_name`, d_cluster.n), CAST(t.`cluster_id` AS STRING)) AS nm_cluster, COALESCE(concat(COALESCE(t.`cluster_name`, d_cluster.n), ' (', CAST(t.`cluster_id` AS STRING), ')'), CAST(t.`cluster_id` AS STRING)) AS n_cluster, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS ws_name, CASE WHEN COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) IS NULL THEN COALESCE(COALESCE(t.`cluster_name`, d_cluster.n), CAST(t.`cluster_id` AS STRING)) ELSE concat(COALESCE(COALESCE(t.`cluster_name`, d_cluster.n), CAST(t.`cluster_id` AS STRING)), ' · ', COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING))) END AS lbl_cluster FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.compute_cluster_config_posture t LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id, max(name) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_workspace GROUP BY CAST(workspace_id AS STRING)) d_workspace ON d_workspace.workspace_id = CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING) LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id, CAST(cluster_id AS STRING) AS cluster_id, max(cluster_name) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_cluster GROUP BY CAST(workspace_id AS STRING), CAST(cluster_id AS STRING)) d_cluster ON d_cluster.workspace_id = CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING) AND d_cluster.cluster_id = CAST(t.`cluster_id` AS STRING))
WHERE (array_contains(:workspace, COALESCE(ws_name, '')) OR array_contains(:workspace, 'all')) AND status IN ('CRITICAL', 'WARN')
ORDER BY CASE status WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, n_cluster
LIMIT 50

SELECT c.title AS check_title,
       c.page AS page,
       CASE WHEN l.query_id IS NULL THEN 'Not run'
            WHEN NOT l.ok THEN 'Not assessed'
            WHEN l.critical > 0 THEN 'Critical'
            WHEN l.warn > 0 THEN 'Warn'
            WHEN l.has_status THEN 'OK'
            WHEN l.row_count = 0 THEN 'No rows'
            ELSE 'Listed' END AS verdict,
       l.row_count AS row_count,
       l.critical AS critical_rows,
       l.warn AS warn_rows,
       l.error AS error
FROM (VALUES
       (0, 'compute_cluster_config_posture', 'Cluster setup risks', 'Configuration'),
       (1, 'compute_warehouse_config_posture', 'Warehouse setup risks', 'Configuration')) AS c(ord, query_id, title, page)
LEFT JOIN databricks_audit_dashboard.snapshot_log l ON l.query_id = c.query_id
ORDER BY CASE WHEN l.critical > 0 THEN 0 WHEN l.warn > 0 THEN 1 WHEN NOT l.ok THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, c.ord
